harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker` as the native SysV service `inventory-worker`, running under the dedicated locked `inventorysvc` account. The service is enabled at runlevels 3–5 and recovered automatically after node1 rebooted. CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the locked system account `inventorysvc` with `/sbin/nologin`.
Installed and enabled a CentOS 5-compatible SysV init service named `inventory-worker`.
Verified managed start, stop, status, and restart behavior.
Verified the live worker runs as UID 101/GID 102, not root.
Restarted node1 exactly once and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service, account, configuration, executable, OS release, and kernel recovered after reboot.

evidence.summary: Shows the locked nologin system account and the worker process running with inventorysvc UID/GID 101/102.
Shows the installed SysV init script, runlevel enablement, successful service restart, changed PID, and active worker command line.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart output confirms CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID 1f6ca5f0-553a-46e0-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7dae66bb-f18b-4be8-8000-000000000000, and recovered service with matching artifact hashes and correct unprivileged ownership.
